Référence 5904941
|
Créé le 20 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Independant
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Services informatiques
Description de l'entreprise
Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Innova Solutions employs around 50,000 professionals worldwide and reports annual sales approaching $3 billion. Through our global distribution centres in North America, Asia and Europe, we provide our customers with strategic technology and business transformation solutions, enabling them to operate as leaders in their fields. Since the official acquisition of VOLT in September 2023, INNOVA has boosted its capacity to provide effective staffing solutions across a range of industries and skill areas, including IT & Telecoms, Digital Entertainment, Engineering, Finance and Life Sciences.
Description de la fonction
Our client, a leading organization in the Energy Sector, is seeking an experienced Procurement Process Owner to drive procurement excellence through process optimization, digital transformation, and continuous improvement.
You will own end-to-end procurement processes, improve operational efficiency, support system implementations, and collaborate with Procurement, Business, Finance, and IT stakeholders to deliver scalable and compliant procurement solutions.
Key responsibilities
Own, design, and continuously improve procurement processes and supporting tools.
Drive procurement transformation and process improvement initiatives.
Lead cross-functional projects from planning through implementation.
Support the adoption of new procurement processes, systems, and ways of working.
Develop procurement KPIs, reporting, and performance insights.
Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and optimization.
Create process documentation and support training activities.
Act as a subject matter expert for procurement processes and systems.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance, and regulatory requirements.
Required experience & skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Business, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Strong knowledge of procurement processes, especially Procure-to-Pay (P2P).
Experience in procurement process design, optimization, and transformation.
Strong knowledge of:
SAP MM (S/4HANA)
SAP Public Cloud
SAP Fiori
Experience with digital procurement solutions and reporting tools.
Strong analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
Structured, hands-on, and process-oriented mindset.
Experience driving change and working across multidisciplinary teams.
Language requirements:
Professional English proficiency.
Good command of French and/or Dutch.
Location & work model
Brussels, belgium | Hybrid working model
Join a forward-thinking Energy Sector organization where you can shape procurement capabilities, drive innovation, and contribute to operational excellence.
